predeclared_decision.delta: learned - analytical, paired root-cluster bootstrap 95% CI on VAL roots
predeclared_decision.PROMISING: known-label precision delta CI lower > 0 AND hit@4 delta CI lower > -0.02
predeclared_decision.ANALYTICAL_AHEAD: analytical significantly better on hit@4 or precision (delta CI upper < 0) AND learned not significantly better on the other
predeclared_decision.TIED: both delta CIs contain 0 and both |point deltas| < 0.02
predeclared_decision.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else (e.g. a significant trade-off: learned better precision, analytical better hit)

test_policy: NO new arm, pool, lambda, budget or seed is evaluated on or chosen from the exposed TEST split; TEST is only re-run byte-for-byte as archived evidence with the archived SAMPLER_V1 configuration
fairness: same snapshot, legality mask, raw cap 8 x (pool or M) draws with replacement, first unique kept; rerank arms share the pool size; ranker-only is a disclosed full-legal-catalogue scorer
